## DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored API

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored is a large language model by DeepSeek, available on the Venice API as `deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored is an abliterated, uncensored variant of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters (8B active on input, 16B on output) and a 1M-token context window. It natively processes images and text, with strong reasoning, coding, and agentic performance and no content-filtering guardrails.

### DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored` | Standard | Private | $0.33 / $1.32 per 1M |

### DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | DeepSeek |
| Released | Oct 23, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, high, max |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "high"
  }'
```
